meta.descripcion: AI clips, editing, captions, Brand Kit and publishing to TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and Facebook: everything Clipfine does for agencies and podcasts.

portada.texto: From the long episode to clips published on four networks, for every client your agency runs. This is what you can use today.

ia.texto: Upload the episode and get its best moments, each one with the reason why.

edicion.texto: Adjust the span, cut what's extra and frame whoever is talking, no video skills needed.

textos.texto: Captions that are easy to read and designed text, ready for social.

imagenes.texto: Add photos, logos or cut-out people on top of the clip.

marca.texto: Every client with its logo, colors and style, on all of its clips.

calidad.texto: Sharp clips and a preview of how they look on each network.

importar.texto: The recorded episode or the live stream, with no extra steps.

publicar.texto: Schedule each clip on all four networks and follow its status from a calendar.

metricas.texto: Which clip worked, on which platform and why, so you can decide the next one and show the client.

equipo.texto: Many clients and many people working, without stepping on each other.

app.texto: The same as the web, on your phone, in English or Spanish.

momentos.titulo: The best moments, found for you
momentos.texto: Clipfine transcribes the episode and AI picks the parts that stand on their own. You start with a batch of clips, not 90 minutes of video.

puntaje.texto: Every suggested clip comes with a 0–100 score and the reason: strong hook, humor, hot take, quotable line, emotion…

sugeridos.texto: Every moment arrives with a title and a hook line for the first seconds, ready to use or change.

aMano.texto: Read the transcript, play the part, mark where it starts and ends, and open it in the editor.

tramo.texto: Make the clip longer or shorter from its edges so you never lose the start of an idea or the punchline.

cortes.texto: Remove what's extra in the middle of the clip, on the timeline or by tapping words in the transcript.

silencios.texto: One tap marks long silences as cuts, and you review them one by one.

autoEncuadre.texto: The clip follows whoever is talking: it recognizes voices and watches who moves their lips. Every change can be adjusted.

encuadreManual.texto: Move and resize the frame, and add a new framing from any second.

formatos.texto: Vertical for Reels, TikTok and Shorts, square for the feed or horizontal for YouTube.

disenos.texto: Single, Split (two people, one above the other), Landscape and Centered. You can change them in each part of the clip.

fondo.texto: When the video doesn't fill the screen, the rest is filled with the same video, softened, or with black bars for text.

subtitulos.texto: They come from the transcript, with the spoken word highlighted. Drag them up, down or bigger.

corregir.texto: If a word was transcribed wrong, change it or remove it from the captions without touching the timing.

estilos.texto: Pop, Karaoke, Beast, Editorial, Keynote and more, painted with the brand's colors.

textosDiseno.texto: Several fonts, outline, shadow or box, highlighted words in another color and the exact moment they show up.

gancho.texto: A big line in the first seconds so nobody scrolls past.

cta.titulo: Call to action at the end
cta.texto: A closing line like “Watch the full episode”, in a box with the brand's color.

hastaTres.texto: A photo, a logo or a product: drop it on the preview, place it and choose when it shows up.

quitarFondo.texto: Cut a person or an object out of its background with one tap.

contorno.texto: A white border around the cut-out so it pops off the video.

logo.texto: Choose the corner, size and opacity. If the logo has a background, we remove it.

colores.texto: Taken from the logo with one tap or picked by hand, they paint the text and captions.

estiloMarca.texto: Each client's hook and captions always come out in its style.

aplicaSolo.texto: The brand's clips come out with its Brand Kit. On each clip you can change the style or turn off the logo.

render.texto: The original frame rate is kept and the video you uploaded isn't compressed again.

indicador.texto: Each clip tells you whether its quality is excellent, good or low, and what to do if zooming hurts it.

vistaPrevia.titulo: How it looks on each network
vistaPrevia.texto: See the clip with the TikTok, Reels, Shorts or Facebook screen on top, so nothing gets covered.

versionFacebook.texto: If the clip runs over 90 seconds, you choose which part goes to Facebook; the other networks get the full clip.

descargar.texto: Every finished clip downloads ready to post anywhere you want.

subir.texto: Pick the podcast video from your computer and Clipfine transcribes it for you.

restream.texto: Connect Restream and bring in the live recording directly, without waiting for YouTube to process it.

cuatroRedes.texto: Schedule the same clip on TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and Facebook in one step.

porDefecto.texto: Each brand keeps its hashtags and accounts, and they're filled in every time you schedule.

portada.texto: A frame from the video or your own image as the clip's cover.

comoSale.titulo: How it goes out on each network
comoSale.texto: Before scheduling you see whether the caption is longer than a network allows.

calendario.texto: What's scheduled and what's already out, with each network's status on every clip.

editarAgendada.texto: Change the time or the caption, or remove a network, before it goes out.

reintentar.titulo: If a network fails, you'll know
reintentar.texto: See the reason and retry just that network, without posting again where it already went out.

metricasClip.texto: Views, likes, comments, shares, saves, reach and followers gained, per platform and combined.

crecimiento.texto: The views curve since it went out: after an hour, 6 hours, a day and up to 90 days later.

retencion.texto: How many leave in the first 3 seconds, how many watch to the end and how much is watched on average, where the platform shares it.

iaVsRealidad.texto: The score the AI gave each moment next to the real views, and which kind of moment performs best.

resumenPrograma.texto: Totals vs the previous period, best and worst clips, followers per platform and the best time to post.

exportar.titulo: Export as PDF, CSV or Markdown
exportar.texto: A client-ready report, a sheet for Excel or Google Sheets, or a summary for Notion, Slack or email.

seActualiza.texto: Analytics are read automatically for 90 days after publishing, and you see them in the app too.

marcas.texto: Each client has its own space: episodes, clips, calendar, Brand Kit and networks, never mixed.

roles.texto: Owner, editor or viewer: everyone gets in with their role on the brands they work on.

invitaciones.texto: Add someone with their email and name, and they go straight into the brand.

tomar.texto: Whoever takes a clip has it under their name and everyone sees it. If a part is already in another clip, Clipfine warns you.

listos.texto: When a clip is marked done, it shows up in the calendar for someone to schedule it.

autoria.texto: Every clip shows who edited it, who finished it and who scheduled it.

avisos.texto: Know when clips are ready, when someone takes or schedules one and when it's published.

app.texto: Same account, same brands: edit, schedule and check the calendar from your phone.

push.texto: Team notifications reach your phone, and you choose which ones you want.

fotos.texto: Export the finished clip to your phone's gallery.

idiomas.texto: The web and the app are in English and Spanish. For now, episodes are transcribed in Spanish.

cierre.texto: Upload an episode and see the clips you get, with the Brand Kit on and ready to schedule.
